_meta.datasheet: Kyocera CX2016SA crystal unit catalog sheet (as of October 2026)
_meta.datasheet_section: Specifications table; Table 1 ESR; Dimensions; Connection (top view); Recommended land pattern
_meta.notes: 40 MHz fundamental, CL 8 pF, +/-15 ppm at 25 C, +/-50 ppm over -40..+125 C, ESR 50 ohm max (40-60 MHz), drive 10 uW typ / 200 uW max, C0 2 pF max, AEC-Q200. Pins 1 and 3 = crystal, 2 and 4 = GND (lid). No shock rating published.
_meta.abs_max_notes: Drive level DL 10 µW typ, 200 µW max (Kyocera CX2016SA sheet p1 spec table). No voltage ratings for a crystal.
